name: stackbone
description: Agent skills for Stackbone: the platform for building and hosting durable AI agents. Creators author a workspace of deep agents (deepagents/LangGraph, served over the standard OpenAI/Anthropic chat endpoints) and durable workflows on @stackbone/sdk; organizations run them as agents in their own cloud with Postgres (Drizzle), object storage, durable execution (Redis), a human-in-the-loop inbox and a model gateway. The seven skills teach a coding agent how to work: the shapes and rules of the SDK (stackbone), how to drive the CLI (stackbone-cli), how to start a piece from a description (stackbone-coder), how to locate the cause of a failure (stackbone-debug), how to wire a workspace to the outside with connections, triggers and destinations (stackbone-integrations), how to put limits on a running agent (stackbone-guardrails) and how to measure whether it works (stackbone-evals). Every API detail, flag and error code is read from the Stackbone docs over MCP (https://docs.stackbone.ai/mcp, tools search_docs / get_doc / list_docs), or from https://docs.stackbone.ai/llms.txt without an MCP client.
